default.description: Default permissions for SSHSpan. Capabilities gate what the WEBVIEW may call over IPC; they do not gate the Rust side. Only what the shipped renderer uses: event listen/unlisten (IPC events, drag and drop), webview zoom and clipboard text. No core:default: it carries core:tray, core:menu, core:image and core:resources, which let a page replace or remove the Rust-built tray (Lock Vault / Quit) and read files by path. Every file picker in this app is opened from Rust (app.dialog()), which does not consult the ACL, so no dialog grants are needed.
